title: ZAgentic shared skill naming & documentation value-domain conventions

authority_claim.role: single repo-side authority for the shared core
authority_claim.note: doc-map binding (authority-id reference.skill-conventions) and ADR 0007 / ontology.schema.json pointers are landed in roadmap 1-2-2; this file is the source those pointers name. Self-declaration only — extract.py does not parse JSON, so no MAP binding is created by this file itself; the binding lives on docs/README.md.

provenance.rationale: Authored from verified consumer obligations (SCOPED-CONTEXT Q3/Q4/Q5 取证), never derived from a prior docs artifact. The existing schema is an artifact of the docs system under governance and may carry its own defects; seeding from it repeats the case-2 baseline error and propagates defects forward.

scope.boundary_rule: a value a second skill uses to constrain its own output is shared; a value only the owner consumes is private

excluded_layers.semantic_payload: per-kind Job / Does NOT belong there / Must-write sections (kind-templates.md, canonical-preset.json) — private to zj-docs-ontology; architecture has its own View table, so a single ruler would be a self-made-ruler trap
excluded_layers.process_and_diagnostics: category set, lifecycle, tombstone, MAP_* / PAGE_* / AUTHORITY_* / SOURCE_* / ADR_* diagnostic codes — private to their owning skill; never in the shared core

naming-syntax-core.summary: Lowercase, hyphen-separated names that encode what a thing is — never when it was written, which revision it is, or how current it is.
naming-syntax-core.applies_to: any skill-owned artifact name that a second skill constrains (architecture view page stems, ontology <topic> keys, kebab-case audits)

rules.statement: name must be lowercase and hyphen-separated (alphanumeric segments joined by single hyphens)
name must not encode a date, bare year, or commit sha
name must not encode a version number or trailing bare revision number
name must not encode a temporary-status token

naming-syntax-core.notes: Prefix families and topic-scoped private tokens are consumer-private extensions declared per skill; they must not be injected into this shared source (closed-schema check 1). One cause per name; a date finding suppresses the version finding for that name.

doc-kind.summary: The closed vocabulary of frontmatter doc-kind values.

authority.summary: The closed vocabulary of frontmatter authority values and its primary binding semantics.

binding.statement: a page declaring authority: primary must declare exactly one authority-id, and the doc-map must bind that id to exactly one page

layers.checks: one authority-id bound to one page (MAP layer)
no duplicate id across pages; primary carries an id; map and page agree

binding.notes: These two layers can both fire on one id as two distinct defects. Diagnostic codes stay in the owning skill; only the binding semantics are shared.

extension_reservation.statement: Per-skill private terms (e.g. an architecture view prefix family, a topic batch token) are extensions, declared by each consuming skill. Any extension term appearing in this shared source or in an inlined generated block is a closed-schema violation (non-zero).
extension_reservation.reason: core/extension split — extension must never leak into the shared ruler
